summary: Iteration 6 (Liberty Bells currency). Backend: 51/51 pytest tests green — 40 prior + 11 new iter-6 tests in 2 new classes (TestBellsBackend, TestRevenueCatBells). Confirmed: (a) new player starts with bells=3, player_public includes bells, no _id leaks in POST /api/players or GET /api/players/{id}; (b) GET /api/bell-packs returns 3 packs [bells_5(5,$0.99), bells_20(20,$2.99), bells_50(50,$4.99,best_value=true)] with fallback_price; (c) POST /api/players/{id}/complete-level with bells_earned=N increments player.bells (regression: coins/score/dishes_cooked/unlock/weekly still correct); default bells_earned=0 leaves bells unchanged; (d) POST /api/players/{id}/spend-bells decrements bells (3->2), 400 'Not enough Liberty Bells' when insufficient, 404 for unknown player; (e) POST /api/revenuecat/webhook with NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE + product_id bells_5/bells_20/bells_50 grants correct bells to player.bells with currency='bells' response, coins stay unchanged, duplicate transaction_id returns {duplicate:true} (no double grant), unknown product 400; (f) coins webhook response updated to include currency='coins' — existing coin regression tests still pass. Frontend (mobile 390x844): (1) home shows tappable bell-balance chip '🔔3' next to coin-balance chip, tapping routes to /coin-store; (2) /coin-store shows header coin+bell balances, '🪙 COIN PACKS' section with pack-coins_500/1200/3000 AND '🔔 LIBERTY BELLS' section with pack-bells_5/bells_20/bells_50 (BEST VALUE badge on bells_50), buying any pack on web shows toast 'Purchases activate after you publish a build'; (3) /cooking-result FAIL view (completed=0) shows coins-earned/bells-earned/score-earned stats + retry-bell-button 'Retry Level 🔔 1 You have 3 🔔'; tapping retry with a real player calls spend-bells API and navigates to /game (verified navigation succeeded); (4) /cooking-result WIN view (completed=1) shows bells-earned '+3 BELLS' stat, continue-button, NO retry-bell-button; (5) /serve deep-link now loads (RED-SCREEN BUG FIXED - see below) and shows serve-bells 🔔 chip alongside serve-coins chip; perfect-serve +N 🔔 feedback code path confirmed in serve.tsx:226 (`Perfect! +${tip} 🪙 +${bellTip} 🔔...`). Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. RN-web shadow*/textShadow* deprecation warnings on web are still emitted and explicitly OK-to-ignore per review_request.
action_items: Main agent: verify the fix I applied to /app/frontend/app/serve.tsx (moved extraServings state declaration before the customers useMemo) — the previous ordering caused an 'Uncaught Error: Cannot access extraServings before initialization' RN red screen that broke every /serve session. Consider adding an ESLint rule (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps + no-use-before-define) to catch TDZ violations in future.
Optional: REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_AUTH must be set to a strong secret in production .env before shipping — currently empty for preview testing (webhook accepts unauthenticated calls).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py revenuecat/webhook now returns `currency` field alongside `granted` — nice for client-side telemetry. Idempotency is preserved (rc_purchases row inserted before $inc). Unified PRODUCT_COINS / PRODUCT_BELLS maps keep the currency branch clean.

server.py spend-bells uses `max(1, int(payload.amount))` — good input clamp, prevents 0/negative from bypassing the balance check. STARTING_BELLS=3 and RETRY_BELL_COST=1 are module-level constants (single source of truth).
server.py complete-level clamps bells_earned via `max(0, result.bells_earned)` — prevents negative bells from a spoofed client.
server.py bell-packs mirrors coin-packs exactly — both use fallback_price and mark the top tier best_value=true. Consistent UX.

frontend/app/serve.tsx: FIXED critical TDZ bug where `extraServings` (declared on original line 97 via useState) was referenced in the `customers` useMemo dependency array on line 82 — since useMemo initializes during the render function's synchronous execution, this threw `Cannot access 'extraServings' before initialization`. Moved the useState declaration above the useMemo.
frontend/app/cooking-result.tsx retry flow correctly guards on `myBells < 1` and shows a buy-bells-link to /coin-store when the player is out — good freemium UX.
frontend/app/coin-store.tsx renders both sections + iap-notice banner and defers real IAP behind Platform.OS !== 'web' (fallback toast). Best-value badge only appears on bells_50 as spec'd.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (+11 iter-6 tests in TestBellsBackend + TestRevenueCatBells; also updated TestRevenueCatWebhook assertion to include new `currency` field)
/app/frontend/app/serve.tsx (moved `const [extraServings, setExtraServings] = useState(0);` above the `customers` useMemo to fix TDZ red-screen crash)
